pre-commit.prompt:
Review the staged changes in this commit. Focus on the diff and highlight any issues before I commit.

After the review, if any significant patterns were identified (security issues, performance anti-patterns, recurring mistakes, or architectural decisions), recommend running:

claude task pattern-codifier 'Codify patterns from this review session focusing on [specific domain]'

Only recommend pattern codification if the review identified learnings worth documenting.

post-code-review.description: Optional: Run pattern-codifier after code reviews to extract learnings
post-code-review.prompt:
Extract and codify patterns from the recent code review session. Focus on:
- Security vulnerabilities that were fixed
- Performance anti-patterns that were corrected
- Pre-commit hook violations that were resolved
- Recurring review feedback worth documenting

Only create patterns if there are significant learnings to capture.
post-code-review.note: Enable by setting 'enabled': true. This will automatically run pattern-codifier after every code review. Most users prefer manual invocation for more control.
